## Load in Libraries and Set Working Directory

```{r, include=FALSE}
setwd(this.path::here())

library(tidyverse)
library(dada2)
library(DECIPHER)
library(phangorn)
library(Biostrings)
library(ape)
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
```

## Load in Data

```{r}
#asv table
seqtab_nochim <- readRDS("../results/dada2/seqtab_nochim.rds")
#taxonomy table
taxa <- readRDS("../results/taxonomy/taxonomy.rds")

```

Clean metadata
```{r}
#metadata
meta <- read.csv("../data/metadata/italiantable.csv", header = FALSE)

#get rid of columns that aren't needed
meta <- meta[,c(1,14)]
colnames(meta)<-c("Sample", "Location")

#add a more succinct col
meta <- meta %>%
dplyr::mutate(Group = ifelse(meta$Location == "Italy:Toscany, Florence", "EU", "BF"))
#remove location col now
meta <- meta[,c(1,3)]
#make the group a factor
meta$Group <- factor(
  meta$Group,
  levels = c("EU", "BF")
)

meta
```

## Extract ASV Sequences

```{r}
seqs <- getSequences(seqtab_nochim)
names(seqs) <- seqs
```

## Multiple Sequence Alignment

```{r}
#aligning every ASV to every other ASV
dna <- DNAStringSet(seqs)
alignment <- AlignSeqs(dna, anchor = NA)
```
